name: Ritlecitinib
description: Kinase inhibitor taken by mouth that irreversibly blocks JAK3 and TEC-family kinases

note.text: Alopecia areata is an autoimmune disease. Litfulo is not a treatment for male pattern hair loss.

bullets: **Irreversibly blocks** the ATP binding site of JAK3 and TEC-family kinases
**In cells,** it blocks cytokine-induced STAT activation via JAK3
**Relevance** of each enzyme to the effect is not known, per the label
**In dogs,** high doses caused reversible hearing changes
SALT 20 or less at week 24: 23% (50 mg) vs 2%

practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak within 1 hour; many pathways (GST, CYP enzymes)
practical.monitored: Lymphocytes and platelets before starting; infections

regulatory.text: Boxed warning: infections, cancer, heart, clots

references: King et al., Lancet, ALLEGRO-2b/3, May 2023
